name: mac-mcp
description: Let your AI apps use your Mac: a local server and menu bar app that lets Claude, ChatGPT, Codex and other MCP apps work in your Mac's apps, files, terminal and browser, with approvals you control.

paragraphs: Let your AI apps use your Mac. Mac MCP is a local server and menu bar app that lets Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, OpenCode and other MCP apps work in your Mac's apps, files, terminal and browser, with approvals you control. It is for people who already work with an AI app and want it to act on their Mac, not just talk about it.
Watch the 40-second demo · Website: bulutarkan.github.io/mac-mcp · Install · MIT
Quick install: download the .pkg from the latest release (Apple Silicon, macOS 14 or later), or run the installer on any Mac with macOS 13 or later:
features: It works inside your apps. Your AI app opens Notes, looks through a folder in Finder or drafts a reply in Mail through macOS Accessibility, using the same buttons and menus you do. Files and the terminal are there too.

It browses where you can see it. Visible, non-focus-stealing browser automation in Safari and Chrome: it works in a tab while you keep using your Mac, and frames the tab so you can see what it touches.
It hands off work and reports back. Delegate a task to a Codex, Claude Code or OpenCode agent and read a report of what it did; Scheduled Tasks (experimental) run AI tasks and scripts on a schedule.
